chapters: Jano' ba' jix duu maa'n oi'ñga' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu ñi'ook bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gio ua'nak bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu Judaa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' no'x bhɨɨya' jix duñia' bɨx pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ pai' bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu vaakax; gio ba' bɨɨx juana' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' bɨx mi'p xikoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu vaakax bɨɨx tu'x a'bhar makgɨrxi.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Nabukodonosor ka't bhaan gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Mitriidates jix maa jix duñia' gu Sesbassar gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix bhai'x jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham tu duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv; gio ba' ko'kmarak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' kavaayo jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' oo'm jixchamaam.

Na pai' dhuuk dhɨt ɨɨbhidham tattat na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix búup gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix daa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Netineos jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu Llegado gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bɨx gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv kua'da' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't.

Jano' ba' jix maa tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jugi bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios na ba' gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano gu gɨ' suudai' gu Joppe jurtu'nka' aagak gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gook namkia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook kua'da' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx tɨbiap gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook jiix na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Jesuaa gio gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Kadmiel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu enadad gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jajannulhi'ñ bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Asap bɨɨx na ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' alabaa'n gu ñi'ook tɨtdada' gu Jawatan Dios am:―Ja'pji; na gu' jix bhai' na gu' na ba' bɨɨx tas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jootos.
Jano' ba' mui'x jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas ɨɨbhidham tattat daraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buupui gu vaak ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook mui'x bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook suanda' gu ja'tkam; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx jix gɨ' tɨroon bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu Oyendo gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sorobabeel ɨɨbhidham tattat gui'p; na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan dɨr gu tanoolh gu Esar-addoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sorobabeel gu Jesuaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham tattat gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Artajerjes gu Bislam gu Mitriidates gu Tabeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia; gio ba' gu'p gu ñi'ook ka't.

Jano' ba' dhi' bhaan gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes; mi' dhɨr tu duukam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judiios tu' no'ch tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem; gio ba' kiicham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɨ'kora' tu' mii' dhɨr kiicham ua'tulhi'ñ vaak jodai ua'tulhi'ñ dhi' namki'ñdha' baaso cham gu gɨ'kora' ka't.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Reum gu Simsai gu Samaria baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't jix maa gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr kiicham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ'kora' duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk ka't gu Jerusalem aapi' bɨx baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' namki'ñdha' baaso gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham ka't kiicham bɨɨx ka'm tu' ka't jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakam dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na ba' gu gɨ'kora'.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' na pai' dhuuk bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes ka't jiñkai'ñ vupui bhaan gu Reum gu Simsai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jerusalem gu Judiios tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ jano' ba' tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix utu'ñ bɨɨx ka'm oidha' tas gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek; gio ba' kua'da' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Tatnai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Setar-bosnai gui'p; gio ba' chɨkka jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu vaak dhi' ja'tkam vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' dhi'.
Gu' gu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu bhaan daraa gu Judiios cham jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dariio; gio ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Tatnai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Setar-bosnai gu Aparsakêos mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim mɨjɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu ñi'ook dhi' ka't ua'nak; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio bɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' gu Judea gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu jodai; gio ba' jix duu tu duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook daraa; gio ba' chɨkka jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu vaak na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gio tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ mi'p ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' no'ch gu'ch tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu' mui'x va'k ka't jix duñia' pai'x gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' mi' dhɨr gu taat tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Kaldeo dhi' gu vaak tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Babiloonia.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook maa'n oidha' tas gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jum duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix buusñi vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't gu Jerusalem ka't vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Babiloonia gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix buusñi vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Babiloonia jix bɨɨx duu kapbhai' gu Sesbassar ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhi' gu Sesbassar suudai' u'va jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem dɨr jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro ka't jix duñia' jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem aagak gu gɨ'kora' bhaan dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio jix maa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak pai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' ka't gaagam gu Akmetta gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' gɨ' gu Media u'uan gu ñi'ook ka't ua'nak; gio ba' gu Memoria.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas maa'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix maa gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem jum duu gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' pai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhaai'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu jodai gu u'u; gio ba' ka't jix maa gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Nabukodonosor jix buusñi vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't gu Jerusalem gu Babiloonia ka't vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jerusalem pai' ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Tatnai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Setar-bosnai gu Aparsakêos baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu duukam gu vaak dhi' gu Jawatan Dios gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Judiios daraa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak dhi' gu Jawatan Dios pai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx daraa dhi' ja'tkam gu Judiios na ba' jix duñia' gu vaak dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu gɨ'kora' juraa'n namki'ñdha' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ na ba' cham.

Jano' ba' ua'tulhi'ñ bɨɨpɨ'm ali' vaakax gu chuukug ali' karneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tiriik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh cham oi'ñdha'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gio jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook no'x dhi' ka't jix duu gu vaak ka't; gio ba' gu vaak ka't dhi'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ na ba' cham tu' duu dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' gu Dariio; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Tatnai gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Setar-bosnai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio ka't.

Jano' ba' daraa gu Judiios jix duñia' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu aggeo jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Sakariias gu mar gu Iddo; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu Dariio gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adar ka't xijumai oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap bhaan jix duu dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ali' vaakax gu chuukug ali' karneer; gio ba' chiiw bɨx gu Israeel jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas bhaan tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem jurtu'nka' ua'nak u'uan gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gakdhi'ñchix gu ñi'ook maa'n.

Na gu' na gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx xoi'kam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria na ba' jix duñia' gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu Esdras gu mar gu Seraiias gu mar gu Asariias gu mar gu ilkiias.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Sallum gu mar gu Sadok gu mar gu Akîtob.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Amariias gu mar gu Asariias gu mar gu Meraiot.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Seraiias gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Bukki.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Abisue gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Esdras jix tɨ'ɨ gu Babiloonia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't jix maa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Netineos kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem jixchamaam oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tanoolh maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia maa'n jixchamaam gu Jerusalem bhaan jix bhai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu Esdras ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook no'x oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas tu' bɨndak gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' na gu' baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judea gu Jerusalem jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bakia' bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia bɨɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan aagak na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' jix toja jodai ali' vaakax gu chuukug ali' karneer bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jurtu'nka' aagak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨpɨ'm na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu vaak gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes jix maa gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cha'tmam jix toja jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' na jix uam tiriik bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook daak bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Netineos gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios namki'ñdha' baaso.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Esdras jurtu'nka' matda' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx namki' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham palhɨɨp.
Jano' ba' no'x cham jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't koi'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat jix dhaas jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel na ba'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Babiloonia gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pinees gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Itamar gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Dabii gu attus.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sekâniias gu ma'nkam gu Paros gu Sakariias bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chamaam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paat-moab gu Elioenai gu mar gu Sarai bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sekâniias gu mar gu Jaasiel bɨɨx vaik gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adiin gu Ebed gu mar gu Jonataan bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam gu Isaiia gu mar gu Ataliias bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias gu Sebadiias gu mar gu Mikâel bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Joab gu Obadiias gu mar gu Jeiel bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Solomit gu mar gu Josipiias bɨɨx chamaam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bebai gu Sakariias gu mar gu Bebai bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asgad gu Joanaan gu mar gu Kataan bɨɨx chamaam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adonikam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' ja'tkam gu Elipelet gu Jeiel gu Semaiias bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bigbai gu Utai gu Sabud bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim jupaabkamu'n gu Aaba vaik gu tanoolh; gio ba' dhaibu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elieser gu Ariel gu Semaiias gu Elnataan gu Jarib gu Elnataan gu Nataan gu Sakariias gu Mesullam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Joiarib gu Elnataan gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Iddo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Kasipia gu chin gu ñi'ook a'ga ñiokda' gu Iddo gu ja'tkam gu Netineos pai' gu Kasipia na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' aichdhak bhaan jix bhai' gu novɨ chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan no'ch gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Maalii gu mar gu Lebii gu mar gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Serabiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu asabiias bɨɨx gu Isaiia gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Netineos gu Dabii bɨɨx chiñia' jix dhaas na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu Netineos; gio ba' bɨx jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Aaba na ba' vupui bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' no'ch na ba' gu Dios a'aalh na ba' bɨx.

Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' xi'ɨraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam kavaayo bhaamki'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' dua'ñ tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bham; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' xoi'kam bhaan bɨx jix duñia'; gu' gu kavɨk i'iich bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Serebiias gu asabiias bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar na ba' gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook cha'tmam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix bhai'x; gio ba' gook gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' na ja'p jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' kooksɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas tattat gu Israeel gu Jerusalem gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ba' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Aaba maa'n na ba' tu' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu novɨ chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan no'ch jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem vaik gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' maakobh gu tanoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Meremot gu mar gu Uriias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu Eleasar gu mar gu Pinees; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Josabad gu mar gu Jesuaa gu Noadiias gu mar gu Binnui gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.

Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ali' vaakax bɨx gu Israeel gu chuukug kɨɨv ali' karneer ɨ'ɨɨr; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Akabadas dhi' tu'x chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n gu Kananeos gu eteos gu Pereseos gu Jebuseos gu Ammonitas gu Moabitas gu Egipkios gu Amorreos bhaan jurtu'nka'.

Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu kai' abhaar tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu novɨ chiñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' kuupa'n mo'o.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ tu' bɨx jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' tu' daakat bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhaibu tɨi'chu' kɨkbok jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh taata'n tattat bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh dhi' jix gɨ' uañi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taata'n gu ñi'ook no'ch taata'n gu gɨ'kora' taata'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kapbhai' gu noobh gu gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook juruuñdhai namkidhat na ba' dhi' pai' xidhuu gu ñi'ook jix tas duu gu Dios gu vupui chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' juantu'n.

Na gu' na gu' tu duukam jɨɨ'ñdhat; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juantu'n cham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios va'k bhaan no'ch xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia na ba' koi gu oidha' na ba' gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook na ba' oidha' bhai' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' mi' dhɨr dhi' na gu' no'ch tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka' gu oidha' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kuiñcha gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix duñia' maa'n bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu ma'nkam tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' jix bhai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; na ba' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Gu' gu' mi' dhɨr bɨx tu' daam kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi kuiñcha chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' dhi' gu ñi'ook chɨɨdak dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam dhi' cham tu' bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai'; na gu' jix duñia' dhɨt na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh vupui bhaan tu' uañi'ñ; na gu' cham kuiñcha dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esdras tɨtdada' joi'ndam vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jum daa'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sekâniias gu mar gu Jeiel gu ma'nkam gu Elam gu Esdras; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gu' cham tu'x jai'ch nɨɨra na ba' gu Israeel bhaan dhi'.

Jano' ba' jano' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'vɨ bhaan gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na gu' bamii' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch duduaka' bɨndak; gio ba' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Esdras gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu Israeel jurtu'nka' dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' chiñia' daraa bɨx jum duu chu'p.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios tattat aagak gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix aa' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook.
